> Original MUI X documentation: [Tree View - Accessibility](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/accessibility/) and [Focus](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/focus/). The examples of this page are written for R.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(muiTreeView)
library(htmltools)
```

## Guidelines

The Tree View follows the [WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices for the tree view pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/treeview/): it has the `tree` role, its items the `treeitem` role, and it can be used with the keyboard only. [MUI docs](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/accessibility/#guidelines)

Give the tree an accessible name, so that screen reader users know what it contains. Use `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` with the id of a visible title:

```{r}
fns <- data.frame(
  package = c("muiMaterial", "muiMaterial", "muiMaterial", "muiCharts", "muiCharts", "reactRouter", "reactRouter", "reactRouter"),
  fn = c("Button", "TextField", "Drawer", "BarChart", "PieChart", "Route", "NavLink", "useParams")
)
fns$fn_id <- paste0(fns$package, "::", fns$fn)
fn_items <- asMuiTree(fns, levels = c("package", "fn"), levels_id = c("package", "fn_id"))

div(
  tags$h4(id = "fns-title", "Functions by package"),
  RichTreeView(
    `aria-labelledby` = "fns-title",
    items = fn_items
  )
)
```

## Keyboard interactions

Click on an item of the tree above, then try the keys below. On macOS, use <kbd>⌘ Command</kbd> instead of <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>. [MUI docs](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/accessibility/#keyboard-interactions)

| Keys | Description |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Activates the focused item: expands or collapses it if it has children, selects it otherwise. |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> | Moves the focus to the previous focusable item, without expanding or collapsing it. |
| <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Moves the focus to the next focusable item, without expanding or collapsing it. |
| <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Expands a collapsed item; moves the focus to the first child of an expanded item; does nothing on an end item. |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> | Collapses an expanded item; moves the focus to the parent of a collapsed item; does nothing on a collapsed root item. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> | Focuses the first item of the tree. |
| <kbd>End</kbd> | Focuses the last item of the tree. |
| <kbd>*</kbd> | Expands all the siblings of the focused item. |
| Typing characters | Moves the focus to the next item whose label starts with the typed characters. |

In right-to-left languages, <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> and <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> are switched.

## Selection

### On single-select trees

[MUI docs](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/accessibility/#on-single-select-trees)

| Keys | Description |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggles the selection of the focused item. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Selects the focused item, if it has no children. |

### On multi-select trees

[MUI docs](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/accessibility/#on-multi-select-trees)

| Keys | Description |
|---|---|
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggles the selection of the focused item. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> | Moves the focus and toggles the selection of the previous item. |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Moves the focus and toggles the selection of the next item. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Home</kbd> | Selects the focused item and all the items up to the first one. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>End</kbd> | Selects the focused item and all the items down to the last one. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> | Selects all the items. |

```{r}
RichTreeView(
  `aria-label` = "Functions by package",
  items = fn_items,
  multiSelect = TRUE,
  checkboxSelection = TRUE
)
```

## Focus

### Track item focus

Use `onItemFocus` to know which item has the focus. Click on the tree and move with the arrow keys: [MUI API](https://mui.com/x/api/tree-view/rich-tree-view/#rich-tree-view-prop-onItemFocus)

```{r}
div(
  RichTreeView(
    `aria-label` = "Functions by package",
    items = fn_items,
    onItemFocus = JS(
      "(event, itemId) => { document.getElementById('a11y-focus').textContent = itemId; }"
    )
  ),
  tags$pre("Focused item: ", tags$span(id = "a11y-focus", "none"))
)
```

### Focus disabled items

By default, the keyboard skips the disabled items. Use `disabledItemsFocusable = TRUE` to let them receive the focus, as shown in [Rich Tree View - Items](rich-tree-view-items.html#focus-disabled-items).

### Focus a specific item

Moving the focus from code uses the MUI imperative API (`apiRef`), which relies on a React hook not available from R. [MUI docs](https://mui.com/x/react-tree-view/rich-tree-view/focus/#focus-a-specific-item)
